nom: Party of You Grime Scene Exfoliating Cushion Toner

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mostly gentle results with no irritation or dryness, though one reviewer had a severe allergic reaction with itching and breakouts, and another with rosacea found it mildly irritating but kept using it.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in a dry climate, describe the toner as hydrating and gentle enough for daily use, with one noting a slightly drying effect if used more than once a day.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say the milky formula does not strip natural oils the way other toners do, leaving skin hydrated and plump.

concerns.blemishes: Reviewers using this as an exfoliating step for breakouts report fewer or smaller blemishes and clearer skin over a few weeks, though a couple saw no real change in texture or breakouts even after regular use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report calmer, less red skin after use, while one with rosacea found it irritated her a little and one reviewer had a severe allergic reaction with itching and irritation.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some who normally find toners drying, describe the milky formula as hydrating rather than stripping, though a few note a slight tightness or drying feeling that they manage by following with a moisturizer.

aspects.libelle: Milky, creamy texture that layers well
Light, pleasant scent for most users
A few dislike the scent or find it chemical
Slight sting or tingle on application

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used this product for a few weeks and saw no improvement in my skin. I love exfoliating products since i have acne so i had high hopes for this product. The texture was nice and absorbed however there were no changes to the texture of my skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I usually don't check cosmetics on Yuka, but since this is a new brand and I'm seeing it for the first time, I decided to look at the ingredients. Phenoxyethanol and PEG-100 Stearate caught my attention and made me a bit cautious. Unfortunately, after trying this toner, I experienced a severe allergic reaction : my skin broke out, became very itchy, and felt extremely irritated. While the pad is generously saturated with product, it was far too harsh for my skin. Personally, I prefer lighter, more hydrating formulas, and due to this reaction, this toner is definitely not a good match for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone with combination skin, I loved this toner because unlike other toners, this did not make me feel like my skin was stripped of its natural oils. The texture is thick, but once you start putting it on your skin it thins out and left my skin feeling hydrated and plump. It left my skin with a little glow which I'm sure is from the exfoliating properties. The packaging is fun and I would definitely recommend this to anyone.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoyed this product a lot! My rosacea not so much, but I'm going to keep using it. It's very smooth almost lotion like consistency. A little goes a long way whether you put it on a cotton pad or use your fingers. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Most toners dry you out but this one does not. It irritated my rosacea a little but not too bad.

In full transparency, I had very low expectations for this product - usually flashy packaging, means mediocre results. I cannot tell you how much my opinion has changed since even the first test patch of this product. The consistency is like this very liquidy/milky lightweight moisturizer, yet it functions as a very gental exfoliater. It is the perfect base under my moisturizer- I have dry skin. As a bonus, I have noticed all of my break ups clearing up. On a work trip a few months ago I got a facial and was talking to the facialist about my severe breakouts; she mentioned needing something very gentle yet exfoliating that could really clear out all that was happening under my skin. I got this product shorty after that and this has honestly been the perfect product to help.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] THIS STUFF IS SO GOOD!!!! I have extremely sensitive and dry skin, and the PHA doesn't dry my skin out at all. It also layers so nicely under products. It didn't break me out, soothed my redness a bit, and it feels nice, almost milky, but not as runny. This bottle is going to last me a while and I use it every morning! I also don't need to worry about it shattering vs brands that have glass packaging
